auditScope.description: Security audit for open-source candidate modules before extraction

modules.name: circuitBreaker
modules.notes: Pure TypeScript implementation of Circuit Breaker pattern. No external dependencies, no sensitive data. Ready for open-sourcing.

modules.name: accessibility
modules.notes: Pure TypeScript accessibility utility functions. No sensitive data. Ready for open-sourcing.

modules.name: rng

findings.description: This is NOT a cryptographic random number generator. Uses Linear Congruential Generator (LCG) algorithm.
findings.recommendation: Document clearly that this should not be used for security-sensitive operations like token generation or encryption keys.

requiredActions: Add prominent documentation that this is not cryptographically secure
modules.notes: Pure algorithmic implementation for deterministic game behavior. No sensitive data. Ready for open-sourcing with proper documentation.

modules.name: structuredData

findings.description: Hardcoded business information: name 'Master Locksmith Amsterdam', URL 'https://masterlocksmith.nl'
findings.recommendation: Replace with configurable parameters or remove business-specific defaults
Remove hardcoded phone number, make it a required parameter
Remove hardcoded email, make it a required parameter

findings.description: Hardcoded social media URLs: Facebook and Instagram links
findings.recommendation: Make social media links configurable or remove defaults

findings.description: Service schema references 'Master Locksmith Amsterdam' and 'https://masterlocksmith.nl'

requiredActions: Remove hardcoded business name, phone, email, and URLs from getOrganizationSchema()
Refactor to accept organization data as parameters
Remove business-specific defaults from getServiceSchema() and getReviewSchema()
modules.notes: Contains hardcoded business information specific to the source project. Must be sanitized before open-sourcing. The utility functions themselves are valuable and reusable.

modules.name: canvas3D
modules.notes: Pure visual/3D rendering components using React Three Fiber. No sensitive data. Ready for open-sourcing. Note: GSAP has commercial license considerations.

modules.name: gameEngine
modules.notes: Pure game logic implementation. No sensitive data, no external API calls. Ready for open-sourcing.

modules.name: gameComponents
modules.notes: Pure UI components for game interface. No sensitive data. Ready for open-sourcing.

modules.name: whatsapp

findings.description: Imports prisma from '../database/client' - project-specific database connection
findings.recommendation: Refactor to accept database client as a dependency injection parameter

findings.description: Imports logger from '../utils/validation' - project-specific logging utility
findings.recommendation: Replace with configurable logger or remove dependency

requiredActions: Refactor to use dependency injection for database client
Make logger configurable or use console-based fallback
Document that whatsapp-web.js uses unofficial WhatsApp API
modules.notes: No hardcoded secrets in the module itself. The source project (itsalive) has JWT_SECRET fallbacks in other files but those are not part of this module. Requires refactoring for standalone use.
